name: oxylabs
description: Oxylabs Agent Skills, vendored verbatim from github.com/oxylabs/agent-skills @ 026d180a1ad3e1918c0b0a5ccea6e5ca867406fe (MIT, see LICENSE): proxies (Residential/Mobile/DC/ISP/Dedicated), web-unblocker, agent-browser. Only the products we hold credentials for; video-data and web-scraper-api are deliberately not vendored. Credentials come from env (OXY_RES_*, OXY_DC_*, OXYLABS_USERNAME/PASSWORD, OXY_AB_*), never from files. Update by re-copying skills/<name>/ from a newer upstream commit and bumping the SHA here.
